svg.title: Phase 1 — Quantitative pipeline detailed flow
svg.desc: Eight-stage detailed flowchart of Phase 1, from file upload through to DuckDB live facts, with per-stage inputs and outputs annotated.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens in stage 1 file registration?')
sendPrompt('What does the file registration output look like?')
g.text: OUT: SHA-256 hash · dim_source row · upload timestamp

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does sheet and region enumeration work?')

g.text: IN: file (CSV = 1 region, Excel = N sheets)
OUT: ordered list of logical regions + inferred type

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does pre-normalization strip and convert?')
sendPrompt('What does the clean Polars DataFrame look like after stage 3?')
g.text: OUT: clean DataFrame · stripped metadata blob · notes routed to Phase 2

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does unit and period detection work in stage 4?')
sendPrompt('What unit annotation does stage 4 produce?')
sendPrompt('What does the schema mapping LLM call do in stage 5?')
sendPrompt('What JSON does the schema mapper LLM output?')
g.text: IN: headers + 5 sample rows + unit annotations

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What rules do the stage 6 validators check?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a validation check fails?')
g.text: IN: mapping JSON + clean DataFrame + TOTAL row
OUT: PASS with conflicts list OR FAIL → retry Stage 5

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the onboarding conversation message look like?')
sendPrompt('How is the onboarding message split between deterministic and LLM-generated content?')
g.text: IN: conflicts list + all stage outputs (deterministic)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What counts as a valid user acknowledgment?')
sendPrompt('What happens when facts are promoted to live in stage 8?')
sendPrompt('What citation envelope is written in stage 8?')
g.text: IN: staging facts + user conflict choices
OUT: live.fact_metrics · derived KPIs · citation envelopes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is queryable after Phase 1 completes?')
g.text: fact_metrics queryable · citation envelopes written · derived KPIs computed · notes in ChromaDB
